requirements.text: Create, rename, list, search, sort, paginate, and delete private folders in the active workspace; mobile cards replace unavailable tables without a misleading view selector, and long active-filter values/no-result text stay within the list card.
Deleting one or more folders preserves their links and clears folder_id on each affected link.
Folder lists show link count and click/event rollups.
Folder queries, mutations, counts, and rollups are scoped to the active workspace.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Bulk deletion of one or more folders clears folder_id on affected links and never deletes those links.
Folder queries, mutations, link counts, and click/event rollups use only authorized active-workspace resources.
Folder cards and rows visibly show link counts and workspace-safe click and analytics-event rollups.

At mobile widths, folder lists show cards and hide the table selector; long active search values retain their full accessible filter name while truncating visually, and no-result text stays within the folder card.

observedBehaviors: Folders appear as compact rows with counts and row actions.
Search/filter controls and a new-folder action are visible.

implementationEvidence.description: Folder list mutation regression passed in the focused management suites: deleting the only result on the last page returns to page 1 while preserving validated filters, sort, and view; update and bulk mutations also drop the stale page number.
implementationEvidence.reference: docker exec -e DB_CONNECTION=sqlite -e DB_DATABASE=:memory: -e DB_URL= linkpilot-parity-smoke php artisan test tests/Feature/Links/LinkManagementTest.php tests/Feature/Folders/FolderManagementTest.php

implementationEvidence.description: Folder behavior tests verify workspace-scoped listing and mutations, link preservation on deletion, link/click/event rollups, and exclusion of deliberately mismatched foreign-workspace link and event rows.
The desktop browser capture shows a folder rollup with 3 links, 2 clicks, and 0 consented events.
At 390x844, the folder card visibly showed 1 link, 14 clicks, and 3 events with no horizontal page overflow.

At 390x844, a 100-character unbroken folder search stays within the active-filter chip and no-results card, with the full accessible filter name retained. A view=table URL renders folders as cards and hides the unavailable table control.
